//: One API docs section per product (.cursor/rules/product-docs-suites.mdc). Platform is the Mintlify site moved here; each self-serve product is its own section inside that product's Help Center suite (`base`), with its own guides (src/api-docs/<key>/) and its own spec (src/data/api/products/<key>/openapi.json; `tab` and `sourceDir` record where they came from in the retired lennd/sessionboard-public-api-docs). `released: false` deploys a product's API pages staff-only, with its Help Center suite (src/data/suites.json, src/lib/staff-only.mjs): super users read and switch to them, everyone else gets a 404. Keep `released` the same as the suite's. `help` is where the Help Center tab points from that product's API pages. Order is the switcher's order.
